propositions: Structurally divergent LLM provider responses can normalize to empty verification results incorrectly treated as valid review outcomes.
Raw-empty and malformed-to-empty verification chunks both produce no usable verification entries but are classified into separate telemetry buckets despite identical downstream decision behavior.

The decision layer already enforces that any finding with no verification entry becomes indeterminate, but telemetry must explicitly distinguish clean parses, recovered parses, empty outcomes, and unrecoverable responses.
Pipeline-level telemetry wiring for outcome_counts is missing in plan_review_decide and code_review_decide consumers despite being shipped in the verify_findings kernel function.
Tolerant Pydantic parsing and bounded retry/self-healing must be preserved to handle supported provider and model variations without schema rigidity.
